13201.meaning2: causes to be taken or fetched; sends for; demands

examples.text: cha corā na laddho vat'āsi amhehi, ajja te vividhāni kammakāraṇāni kāretvā bahudhanaṃ āharāpessāmā'ti cintetvā, udak'aṇṇavaṃ otarituṃ asakkontā rañño āṇāya kopitattā parato gantum'pi avisahantā tatth'eva sussitvā mareyyuṃ.

13203.meaning1: having caused to bring; having had something fetched

examples.text: rājā pasanno aparāni'pi pañca vatthasatāni āharāpetvā therassa pādamūle ṭhapāpesi.

sīghaṃ dāruādīni āharathā'ti gahapatike vatvā gāmamajjhe vuttapakāraṃ gehaṃ kārāpetvā gāmasatato paṇṇākāraṃ āharāpetvā janapadaseṭṭhino santikā dhītaraṃ ānetvā maṅgalaṃ katvā seṭṭhissa sāsanaṃ pahiṇi, idañ'c'idañ'ca mayā katan'ti.
evan'ti te paṭissutvā, padumaṃ āhariṃsu me, tathā nimittaṃ katvāhaṃ, buddhassa abhiropayiṃ.
udakam'āhariṃ sīte, sadā udakam'otariṃ, ayyānaṃ daṇḍabhayabhītā, vācādosabhay'aṭṭitā.
ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, āyasmatā, bhante, channena satthaṃ āharitaṃ. tassa kā gati ko abhisamparāyo'ti?

13210.meaning2: to produce; to deliver; to bring up

examples.text: sace, bhante, na sakkuṇeyyaṃ ādiken'eva āharituṃ, vāmena hatthena sīsaṃ pariggahetvā dakkhiṇena hatthena vaṅk'aṅguliṃ karitvā salohitam'pi āhareyyaṃ.

13211.meaning1: having brought into action; having employed

13212.meaning2: having brought, having fetched, having produced

examples.text: yaṃ hoti kūlapaluggaṃ vā mūsik'ukkaro vā taṃ kājena āharitvā bhājanaṃ karitvā evam'āha, ettha yo icchati taṇḍulapaṭibhastāni vā muggapaṭibhastāni vā kaḷāyapaṭibhastāni vā nikkhipitvā yaṃ icchati taṃ haratū'ti.

13215.meaning1: fetching; captivating; enticing; (or) accessorized; embellished; enhanced
13215.meaning2: which has been added to; dependent on accessories
13215.commentary: (THIa) āharimena rūpenā'ti kesamaṇḍan'ādinā sarīrajagganena c'eva vatth'ābharaṇ'ādinā ca abhisaṅkhārikena rūpena vaṇṇena kittimena cāturiyenā'ti attho.

examples.text: sākuntiko'va sakuṇiṃ, yathā bandhitum'icchati, āharimena rūpena, na maṃ tvaṃ bādhayissasi.

13216.commentary: (DNa) tāvatakaṃ āharīyatan'ti tāvatakaṃ āharāpiyatu gaṇhiyatu, yattakaṃ icchatha, tattakaṃ gaṇhathā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: sace, hotu, bhante, āhariyissatī'ti bhaṇati, corā vattabbā, manussā idh'ūpacaranti apasakkathā'ti.
yāguyā paṭisaṃvidite, tassā parivāro āhariyyati, etaṃ paṭisaṃviditaṃ nāma. bhattena paṭisaṃvidite, tassa parivāro āhariyyati, etaṃ paṭisaṃviditaṃ nāma.

13219.commentary: (DNa) tāvatakaṃ āharīyatan'ti tāvatakaṃ āharāpiyatu gaṇhiyatu, yattakaṃ icchatha, tattakaṃ gaṇhathā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: te mahāgovindaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evam'āhaṃsu, saṃvijjati kho, bho, imesu sattasu rajjesu pahūtaṃ sāpateyyaṃ, tato bhoto yāvatakena attho, tāvatakaṃ āharīyatan'ti.

13221.meaning2: brings, fetches, conveys; takes, collects; uses

examples.text: sac'āyaṃ kumāro tuyhaṃ vā pamādam'anvāya dhātiyā vā pamādam'anvāya kaṭṭhaṃ vā kaṭhalaṃ vā mukhe āhareyya, kin'ti naṃ kareyyāsī'ti?
na me, āvuso, khamanīyaṃ, na yāpanīyaṃ, bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti no paṭikkamanti, abhikkamo'sānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamo. satthaṃ, āvuso sāriputta, āharissāmi, n'āvakaṅkhāmi jīvitan'ti.

13223.commentary: (MNa) satthaṃ āharesī'ti jīvitahārakaṃ satthaṃ āhari, kaṇṭhanāḷiṃ chindi.
13223.notes: mā satthaṃ āharesi lit. 'don't take the knife', i.e. 'don't commit suicide'.

examples.text: sace āyasmato channassa n'atthi patirūpā upaṭṭhākā, ahaṃ āyasmantaṃ channaṃ upaṭṭhahissāmi. mā āyasmā channo satthaṃ āharesi. yāpet'āyasmā channo, yāpentaṃ mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ channaṃ icchāmā'ti.

13224.meaning1: they said; they told; they spoke

examples.text: saccaṃ kir'evam'āhaṃsu, narā ekacciyā idha, kaṭṭhaṃ niplavitaṃ seyyo, na tv'ev'ekacciyo naro'ti.
bhante, sace ayyā imaṃ temāsaṃ idha vaseyyuṃ, mayaṃ saraṇesu patiṭṭhāya sīlāni gaṇheyyāmā'ti āhaṃsu

13225.commentary: (VIN) āhāro nāma udakadantaponaṃ ṭhapetvā yaṃkiñci ajjhoharaṇīyaṃ, eso āhāro nāma. (DNa) āhāraṭṭhitikā'ti paccayaṭṭhitikā.

examples.text: katamo eko dhammo? sabbe sattā āhāraṭṭhitikā.
kāyagutto vacīgutto, āhāre udare yato, saccaṃ karomi niddānaṃ, soraccaṃ me pamocanaṃ.

so sākabhakkho'pi hoti sāmākabhakkho'pi hoti nīvārabhakkho'pi hoti daddulabhakkho'pi hoti haṭabhakkho'pi hoti kaṇabhakkho'pi hoti ācāmabhakkho'pi hoti piññākabhakkho'pi hoti tiṇabhakkho'pi hoti gomayabhakkho'pi hoti, vanamūlaphal'āhāro'pi yāpeti pavattaphalabhojī.

13229.meaning1: depletion of food; running out of sustenance; exhaustion of nutrition

examples.text: devalokato hi devaputtā āyukkhayena puññakkhayena āhārakkhayena kopenā'ti catūhi kāraṇehi cavanti.

13231.meaning1: subsisting on food; dependent on fuel

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, ayaṃ kāyo āhāraṭṭhitiko, āhāraṃ paṭicca tiṭṭhati, anāhāro no tiṭṭhati, evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, pañca nīvaraṇā āhāraṭṭhitikā, āhāraṃ paṭicca tiṭṭhanti, anāhārā no tiṭṭhanti.
katamo eko dhammo abhiññeyyo? sabbe sattā āhāraṭṭhitikā. ayaṃ eko dhammo abhiññeyyo.
chandaparisuddhi, chand'āharānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ chandaparisuddhi-āhāraṇaṃ kataṃ kiṃ? chandaparisuddhi-āhāraṇaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

13233.meaning1: for food; for the purpose of eating

examples.text: yāmakālikaṃ satt'āhakālikaṃ yāvajīvikaṃ āhār'atthāya paṭiggaṇhāti, āpatti dukkaṭassa. ajjhohāre ajjhohāre āpatti dukkaṭassa.

13234.meaning1: ending of sustenance; cessation of fuel

examples.text: āhārasamudayā rūpasamudayo, āhāranirodhā rūpanirodho.
tadāhāranirodhā yaṃ bhūtaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamman'ti yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passati.

13235.meaning1: leading to the cessation of sustenance

examples.text: siyā, āvuso. yato kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako āhārañ'ca pajānāti, āhārasamudayañ'ca pajānāti, āhāranirodhañ'ca pajānāti, āhāranirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadañ'ca pajānāti, ettāvatā'pi kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako sammādiṭṭhi hoti

13236.meaning2: with source of nourishment and guide (of craving)
13236.commentary: (ITIa) catubbidho āhāro ca taṇhāsaṅkhātā netti ca pabhavo samuṭṭhānaṃ etassā'ti āhāranettippabhavaṃ. sabbo'pi vā paccayo āhāro. idha pana taṇhāya nettiggahaṇena gahitattā taṇhāvajjā veditabbā. tasmā āhāro ca netti ca pabhavo etassā'ti āhāranettippabhavaṃ. āhāro eva vā nayan'aṭṭhena pavattan'aṭṭhena nettī'ti evam'pi āhāranettippabhavaṃ.

examples.text: āhāranettippabhavaṃ, n'ālaṃ tadabhinandituṃ, tassa nissaraṇaṃ santaṃ, atakk'āvacaraṃ dhuvaṃ.

13238.grammar: ind, adv, comp, abl sg of āhārapaccaya
13238.meaning1: dependent on food; due to fuel

examples.text: yaṃ kiñci dukkhaṃ sambhoti sabbaṃ āhārapaccayā
yaṃ kiñci dukkhaṃ sambhoti, sabbaṃ āhārapaccayā, āhārānaṃ nirodhena, n'atthi dukkhassa sambhavo.
tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, thokaṃ thokaṃ āhāraṃ āhārayato, pasataṃ pasataṃ, yadi vā muggayūsaṃ, yadi vā kulatthayūsaṃ, yadi vā kaḷāyayūsaṃ, yadi vā hareṇukayūsaṃ, adhimattakasimānaṃ patto kāyo hoti.
tassa mayhaṃ, sāriputta, ekaṃ'y'eva kolaṃ āhāraṃ āhārayato adhimattakasimānaṃ patto kāyo hoti.

13241.meaning1: having the characteristic of food; having the quality of nutriment
13241.commentary: (ANt) kabaḷīkār'āhār'ādīnaṃ oj'aṭṭhamakarūp'āharaṇ'ādi nippariyāyena āhārabhāvo. yathā hi kabaḷīkār'āhāro oj'aṭṭhamakarūp'āharaṇena rūpakāyaṃ upatthambhenti, evaṃ phass'ādayo vedan'ādi-āharaṇena nāmakāyaṃ upatthambheti, tasmā sati'pi janakabhāve upatthambhakabhāvo oj'ādīsu sātisayo labbhamāno mukhyo āhār'aṭṭho'ti te eva nippariyāyena āhāralakkhaṇā dhammā vuttā

examples.text: etasmiñ'hi sutte nippariyāyena āhāralakkhaṇā dhammā āhārā'ti vuttā, idha pana pariyāyena paccayo āhāro'ti vutto. sabbadhammānañ'hi paccayo laddhuṃ vaṭṭati.

13244.meaning1: arising of food; source of sustenance

examples.text: āhārasamudayā rūpasamudayo, āhāranirodhā rūpanirodho.
ko ca, bhikkhave, kāyassa samudayo? āhārasamudayā kāyassa samudayo, āhāranirodhā kāyassa atthaṅ'gamo.

13245.meaning1: (what is) produced by food; generated by sustenance; come into being because of fuel

examples.text: tadāhārasambhavan'ti yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passati. tadāhārasambhavan'ti yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā āhārasambhavassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.

13246.meaning1: produced by food; proceeding from food

examples.text: āhārasambhūto ayaṃ, bhagini, kāyo āhāraṃ nissāya āhāro pahātabbo. taṇhāsambhūto ayaṃ, bhagini, kāyo taṇhaṃ nissāya taṇhā pahātabbā.

13249.meaning2: Chapter 2 of the Nidānasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 2 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

13250.commentary: (JAa) āhārahetū'ti atijighacchapiḷito'pi yo pāpaṃ lāmakakammaṃ na karoti dhammasenāpati-sāriputtatthero viya. ahaṃ panajja āhārahetu pāpaṃ na karomi, tasmā mam'eva sīlaṃ mahantan'ti.

examples.text: ūn'ūdaro yo sahate jighacchaṃ, danto tapassī mitapānabhojano, āhārahetu na karoti pāpaṃ, taṃ ve naraṃ samaṇam'āhu loke.
yo pana bhikkhu adinnaṃ mukhadvāraṃ āhāraṃ āhareyya aññatra udakadantaponā, pācittiyaṃ.
bhojane mattaññuno bhavissāma paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āharissāma n'eva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya yāva'd'eva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya
aṭṭh'aṅgasamannāgataṃ kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo āhāraṃ āhāreti, n'eva davāya, na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya, yāva'd'eva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya
evaṃ vutte, āyasmā moḷiyaphagguno bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, ko nu kho, bhante, viññāṇ'āhāraṃ āhāretī'ti? no kallo pañho'ti bhagavā avoca, āhāretī'ti ahaṃ na vadāmi.

abhijānāmi kho pan'āhaṃ, sāriputta, ekaṃ'y'eva kolaṃ āhāraṃ āhāritā. siyā kho pana te, sāriputta, evam'assa, mahā nūna tena samayena kolo ahosī'ti. na kho pan'etaṃ, sāriputta, evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ. tadā'pi etaparamo'y'eva kolo ahosi seyyathā'pi eta'r'ahi.

13254.meaning1: cutting off food; stopping eating; starvation

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, etadahosi, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ sabbaso āhār'upacchedāya paṭipajjeyyan'ti.

13256.commentary: (VINa) āhār'ūpahāro'ti āhāro ca upahāro ca gahaṇañ'ca dānañ'ca, na amhehi kiñci āhaṭaṃ na upāhaṭaṃ tayā saddhiṃ kayavikkayo vohāro amhākaṃ n'atthī'ti dīpenti.

13257.meaning1: recognition of the unpleasantness of food; perception of the repulsiveness of food
13257.commentary: (SNa) āhāre paṭikūlasaññā'ti odanakummās'ādimhi ajjhoharaṇīye paṭikūlasaññā. (ANa) āhāre paṭikūlasaññaṃ bhāvetī'ti asitapīt'ādi-bhede kabaḷīkāre āhāre gamanapaṭikūl'ādīni nava paṭikūlāni paccavekkhantassa uppajjanakasaññaṃ bhāveti, uppādeti vaḍḍhetī'ti attho. tassā'pi bhāvanānayo visuddhimagge vitthārito'y'eva.

examples.text: pañc'imā, bhikkhave, saññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā honti mah'ānisaṃsā amat'ogadhā amatapariyosānā. katamā pañca? asubhasaññā, maraṇasaññā, ādīnavasaññā, āhāre paṭikūlasaññā, sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā.
āhāre paṭikūlasaññāparicitena, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno cetasā bahulaṃ viharato rasataṇhāya cittaṃ patilīyati patikuṭati pativattati, na sampasāriyati upekkhā vā pāṭikulyatā vā saṇṭhāti.

13258.meaning1: recognizing the unpleasantness of food; perceiving the repulsiveness of food
13258.commentary: (MNa) āhāre paṭikūlasaññī'ti navannaṃ pāṭikulyānaṃ vasena kabaḷīkār'āhāre paṭikūlasaññī.

examples.text: etha, tumhe, bhikkhave, asubh'ānupassino kāye viharatha, āhāre paṭikūlasaññino, sabbaloke anabhiratisaññino, sabbasaṅkhāresu anicc'ānupassino'ti.
byañjanaṃ kho pana bhavaṃ gotamo byañjanamattāya āhāreti, na ca byañjanena ālopaṃ atināmeti.
evaṃ vutte, āyasmā moḷiyaphagguno bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, ko nu kho, bhante, viññāṇ'āhāraṃ āhāretī'ti? no kallo pañho'ti bhagavā avoca, āhāretī'ti ahaṃ na vadāmi.
so kho ahaṃ, aggivessana, oḷārikaṃ āhāraṃ āhāretvā, balaṃ gahetvā, vivicc'eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ.

13261.meaning1: recognition of the unpleasantness of food; perception of the repulsiveness of food

examples.text: katame nava dhammā uppādetabbā? nava saññā, asubhasaññā, maraṇasaññā, āhārepaṭikūlasaññā, sabbaloke-anabhiratisaññā, aniccasaññā, anicce dukkhasaññā, dukkhe anattasaññā, pahānasaññā, virāgasaññā. ime nava dhammā uppādetabbā.

13262.meaningLit: discourse on the repulsiveness of food

examples.text: so kho ahaṃ, aggivessana, thokaṃ thokaṃ āhāraṃ āhāresiṃ, pasataṃ pasataṃ, yadi vā muggayūsaṃ, yadi vā kulatthayūsaṃ, yadi vā kaḷāyayūsaṃ, yadi vā hareṇukayūsaṃ.
yato kho ahaṃ, aggivessana, oḷārikaṃ āhāraṃ āhāresiṃ odanakummāsaṃ, atha me te pañca bhikkhū nibbijja pakkamiṃsu, bāhulliko samaṇo gotamo, padhānavibbhanto, āvatto bāhullāyā'ti.

tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ca mahāmoggallāno āyasmā ca ānando avāpuraṇaṃ ādāya vihāre āhiṇḍanti, abhikkamath'āyasmanto, abhikkamath'āyasmanto! idān'āyasmā sāriputto bhagavato sammukhā sīhanādaṃ nadissatī'ti.
evaṃ, tātā'ti kho te dārakā tassa vuḍḍhapabbajitassa paṭissuṇitvā khurabhaṇḍaṃ ādāya nāḷiyāvāpakena anugharakaṃ anugharakaṃ āhiṇḍanti, loṇam'pi, telam'pi, taṇḍulam'pi, khādanīyam'pi saṃharantā.
evaṃ, devā'ti kho so puriso rañño pasenadissa kosalassa paṭissutvā kevalakappaṃ toraṇavatthuṃ āhiṇḍanto n'āddasa tathārūpaṃ samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā yaṃ rājā pasenadi kosalo payirupāseyya.
evaṃ, ācariyā'ti kho jīvako komārabhacco tassa vejjassa paṭissutvā khaṇittiṃ ādāya takkasilāya samantā yojanaṃ āhiṇḍanto na kiñci abhesajjaṃ addasa.

13271.meaning1: stocked up; heaped up; provided with fuel

examples.text: pakk'odano duddhakhīro'ham'asmi, anutīre mahiyā samānavāso, channā kuṭi āhito gini, atha ce patthayasī pavassa deva.
tiṭṭhaṃ caraṃ nisinno vā, sayāno yāvatāssa vigatamiddho, etaṃ satiṃ adhiṭṭheyya, brahmam'etaṃ vihāram'idha'm'āhu.
idh'eva suddhi iti vādayanti, n'āññesu dhammesu visuddhim'āhu, yaṃ nissitā tattha subhaṃ vadānā, paccekasaccesu puthū niviṭṭhā.
tena kho pana samayena aggikabhāradvājassa brāhmaṇassa nivesane aggi pajjalito hoti āhuti paggahitā.

13278.meaning1: smell of an oblation; whiff of a sacrifice

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma brāhmaṇā āhutigandhena dhāvanti, ettha bhuñjissāma, ettha bhuñjissāmā'ti, evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, santi tiracchānagatā pāṇā gūthabhakkhā, te dūrato'va gūthagandhaṃ ghāyitvā dhāvanti, ettha bhuñjissāma, ettha bhuñjissāmā'ti.
āhuneyyā'ti, bhikkhave, mātāpitūnaṃ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. taṃ kissa hetu? bahukārā, bhikkhave, mātāpitaro, puttānaṃ āpādakā posakā imassa lokassa dassetāro'ti.
evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, aṭṭhahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.

13288.commentary: (VINa) āhundarikā'ti sambādhā. (VISMa) āhundarikan'ti samantato, upari ca ghanasañchannaṃ sambādh'aṭṭhānaṃ.
13288.notes: perhaps related to Sanskrit √huṇḍ to collect, accumulate?

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā tatth'eva rājagahe vassaṃ vasi, tattha hemantaṃ, tattha gimhaṃ. manussā ujjhāyanti khiyyanti vipācenti, āhundarikā samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ disā andhakārā, na imesaṃ disā pakkhāyantī'ti.

13289.meaning2: open, unenclosed; or crowded (like Āḷakamandā); (also ālakamanda)

13290.meaning1: name of a heavenly capital city

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, ānanda, devānaṃ āḷakamandā nāma rājadhānī iddhā c'eva hoti phītā ca bahujanā ca ākiṇṇayakkhā ca subhikkhā ca, evam'eva kho, ānanda, kusāvatī rājadhānī iddhā c'eva ahosi phītā ca bahujanā ca ākiṇṇamanussā ca subhikkhā ca.

13292.commentary: (ANa) hatthako āḷavako'ti hatthato hatthaṃ gatattā evaṃladdhanāmo āḷavako rājaputto.

examples.text: atha kho hatthako āḷavako jaṅghāvihāraṃ anucaṅkamamāno anuvicaramāno addasa bhagavantaṃ gomagge siṃsapāvane paṇṇasanthare nisinnaṃ.

13295.commentary: (SNa) āḷavikā'ti āḷaviyaṃ jātā āḷavinagarato'y'eva ca nikkhamma pabbajitā.

examples.text: atha kho māro pāpimā āḷavikāya bhikkhuniyā bhayaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃsaṃ uppādetu'kāmo vivekamhā cāvetu'kāmo yena āḷavikā bhikkhunī ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āḷavikaṃ bhikkhuniṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi
evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā āḷaviyaṃ viharati gomagge siṃsapāvane paṇṇasanthare.

13298.commentary: (SNa) āḷaviyan'ti āḷavī'ti taṃ raṭṭham'pi nagaram'pi. tañ'ca bhavanaṃ nagarassa avidūre gāvutamatte ṭhitaṃ. bhagavā tattha viharanto taṃ nagaraṃ upanissāya āḷaviyaṃ viharatī'ti vutto.

examples.text: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā vaṅg'īso āḷaviyaṃ viharati agg'āḷave cetiye āyasmatā nigrodhakappena upajjhāyena saddhiṃ.
